mapping.notes: The current profile names result_norm and the server captures an embedding, but it is invoked from the post-decode path and is not the exact current-token stateful prepass boundary.

The public cvec path maps graph block 24 to public layer 23, but the validated path computes alpha as requested_rho times local norm using iterative calibration. The server currently uses a direct scale and budget approximation.
The public cvec path maps graph block 28 to public layer 27, but validated local-norm calibration and current-token replay are not implemented in the server.

The research path projects the direction through model.output and adds alpha_final times the projected direction to logits after result_norm and before sampling. The current server has no faithful output-projection/logit hook.
Public state APIs exist, but the server slot lifecycle has no validated per-request current-token checkpoint integration.
The current server decodes and samples before applying its cvec hook; it does not obtain the query from a no-current-injection prepass over persistent injected state.
No slot-local full-state checkpoint/rollback path is wired into server generation.
The current cvec hook is installed after sampling for a later decode and cannot provide exactly one injected replay of the current token.
The exact research implementation is recoverable from the preserved Git ref, but the current server does not expose the required replay/commit sequence.
Validated C2q uses a separate clean context and aligned clamp responses from C1a. No equivalent live clean-prefix path exists in the current server request loop.
The explicit observe boundary and API plumbing exist, but the server episode is not produced by the exact full C2 reader.

blocking_findings: Current sidecar cvec injection is applied after sampling and affects a later decode rather than the current-token prepass/replay/commit sequence.
Validated block/site injection requires per-site local-norm calibration; the current server does not capture or iterate those boundaries.
Validated final-site behavior is an output-projection logit correction before sampling; no faithful server target is exposed.
The current context implementation shares a model context across slots and has no validated slot-local full-state rollback/replay integration.
Validated C2q depends on a separate clean-prefix context and aligned clamp responses; the current server has no equivalent diagnostic path.
decision: do_not_approximate; preserve the partial profile/API implementation and stop Phase 1C with full-backend verdict not validated
